observations.body: The HR Admin dashboard welcomes Hannah and shows a 25-day leave balance, zero pending leave requests, zero approvals waiting and 28 employees. It displays 2 notifications and version HR Admin v0.1.0. Its navigation includes Dashboard, Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, Approvals, Onboarding and My Profile; quick actions are Request leave, Fill timesheet, Review approvals and Add new hire.
Selecting Approvals opened the Approvals page, which showed the Pending leave requests heading and Nothing waiting for approval.
Selecting Approvals reached the Approvals page at /approvals.
Selecting Onboarding opened the New hire onboarding wizard at step 1, Personal information.
Selecting Onboarding reached New hire onboarding at /onboarding/step-1.
Selecting Directory opened the Employee directory at /directory, displaying 28 employees on page 1 of 3.
Selecting Directory reached the Employee directory at /directory.
The Approvals page contains a Pending leave requests table with Employee, Type, Dates, Days and Reason columns. It currently displays Nothing waiting for approval.

The New hire onboarding wizard is at step 1 of 4, Personal information. It shows First name *, Last name *, Company email * and Phone fields plus a Next button; the stepper lists Personal, Job details, Equipment and Review.

The Employee directory shows 28 employees across three pages, initially sorted by name ascending. It offers a name search textbox, department selector with All departments, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, Previous/Next pagination controls, and columns for name, department, title and email.
Searching the Employee directory for Emily Dawson returned one employee row: Emily Dawson, Engineering, Software Engineer, with page 1 of 1.
The current filtered directory shows one Emily Dawson row (Observation 16). Checking whether selecting this row opens the HR Admin employee profile.
Selecting the directory row for Emily Dawson opened /employees/7, showing her job details and a Back to directory link.
Selecting the directory row for Emily Dawson reached Employee profile at /employees/7.

Employee profile for Emily Dawson shows role Software Engineer, department Engineering, email, phone, manager Michael Reed, and start date Nov 1, 2021. It offers Back to directory and shows no evaluation creation or editing control in the HR Admin view.

The Manager dashboard welcomes Michael and shows a 22-day leave balance, zero pending leave requests and 1 approval waiting. It displays 5 notifications and version Manager v0.1.0. Navigation includes Dashboard, Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile; quick actions are Request leave, Fill timesheet and Review approvals. Approvals navigation, Onboarding navigation and Add new hire are not present in the rendered navigation or quick actions.
Selecting Review approvals opened Approvals, where one leave request was waiting for a decision.
Selecting Review approvals reached the Approvals page at /approvals.
Selecting Directory opened the Employee directory at /directory with 28 employees on page 1 of 3.
Selecting Directory reached the Employee directory at /directory.
The Approvals page shows one pending leave request for George Tanaka: Vacation, Sep 24-26, 2026, 3 days, reason Family visit. The row offers Approve and Reject buttons.

The Employee directory shows 28 employees across three pages, initially sorted by name ascending. It offers a name search textbox, department selector with All departments, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, Previous/Next pagination controls, and columns for name, department, title and email.
Searching the Employee directory for Emily Dawson returned one row for Emily Dawson, Engineering, Software Engineer, on page 1 of 1.
The filtered directory shows Emily Dawson as one row (Observation 24). The rendered row is text, not an announced link or button; checking whether selecting it opens employee details.
Selecting the directory row for Emily Dawson opened /employees/7, showing her job details and a Back to directory link.
Selecting the directory row for Emily Dawson reached Employee profile at /employees/7.

Employee profile for Emily Dawson shows role Software Engineer, department Engineering, email, phone, manager Michael Reed, and start date Nov 1, 2021. It offers Back to directory and shows no evaluation creation or editing control.
Dashboard shows a welcome heading for Emily, leave balance of 18 days, zero pending leave requests, and quick actions. The header shows 3 notifications and app version Employee v0.1.0.
Selecting Directory opened the Employee directory at /directory and displayed 28 employees.
Selecting Directory reached the Employee directory at /directory.

The Employee directory shows 28 employees across three pages, initially sorted by name ascending. The first page offers a name search textbox, a department selector with All departments, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, and Previous/Next pagination controls. It displays name, department, title and email columns.
Searching the Employee directory for Hannah Blake returned one employee row: Hannah Blake, HR, Head of People, with page 1 of 1.
The Employee directory navigation shows a My Leave link at /leave.
Selecting My Leave opened /leave. The page showed 18 available days and one approved request for Aug 11-12, 2026, listed as 3 Vacation days with manager comment Approved – enjoy!
Selecting My Leave reached the My leave page at /leave.

The My leave page shows 18 available days and states that days are deducted when a request is approved. Request history lists one approved Vacation request for Aug 11-12, 2026, with 3 days and manager comment Approved – enjoy!. A New request link opens /leave/new.
Selecting New request opened the New leave request form at /leave/new, with Vacation selected, required start and end dates, an optional Reason, and Submit request and Cancel buttons.
Selecting New request reached the New leave request page at /leave/new.

The New leave request page defaults Leave type to Vacation. Start date and End date are required readonly textboxes, Reason is a textarea, and buttons are Submit request and Cancel. The page states weekends are not counted toward leave.

After one click on the visible Start date textbox, the settled New leave request form shows a September 2026 calendar with weekday headings and selectable dates; Start date remains blank. No Product request was dispatched. The date picker is open.
